Name: Improved Shops
Author: milosnikwiewiorek
Description:
[b]Welcome![/b]

This is an improved shops mod that adds stocks to the different shops like what past mods have done.

Since 1.6 came out, all the shop add-on mods that required the now obsolete Shop Framework Mod had broke.

I liked how some of the shops sold certain things, and I didn't want to see that convenience disappear, so I decided to create an all-in-one shop improvement.

[size=5][b]IMPROVED SHOPS 2.0 IS NOW OUT!!!

[/b][/size]Thank you so much for making me a verified modder on Nexus Mods! I look forward to making even more mods!

Improved Shops 2.0 removes Joja as optional content and merged with original mod. It also removes the need for Core making the setup more simplified. Progression is now optional and you can turn it off as it is on by default. Generic Mod Config Menu is recommended.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

This mod adds items to the following shops:
[list]
[*]Pierre General Store
[*]Marnie's Ranch
[*]Clint's Blacksmith
[*]Robin's Carpentry Shop
[*]Sandy's Oasis
[*]Krobus' Shop
[*]JojaMart
[/list]
[b][size=3]
As of 1.2 Pierre no longer sells Strawberry Seeds or Mixed Seeds. Strawberry Seeds has been moved to Sandy's Oasis and Mixed Seeds has been moved to Krobus. Krobus now sells Ancient Seeds and Sandy sells Ginger Island and 1.6 crops.

As of 1.3, the file structure has been fully revamped. Mail has been introduced. Red Cabbage Seeds has been moved to Sandy's Oasis only being sold on Year 1. Tropical seeds are now locked behind a requirement to unlock the Island Trader first.[/size]

[size=3]As of 1.4 more items that were already in the mod is now unlockable. Check the new information article for more details as there are too many to list here.[/size]

[size=3]1.5 is now out as of 2nd June 2024. This is mainly a Joja update however a small cosmetic fix was done to Sandy's letters. Sandy's letters will now have her lined paper background.[/size]

[size=3]1.6 introduces big craftables to Robin's shop. Thank you for all the lovely suggestions!!!

[/size]1.7 Moves Joja to it's own optional file in preparation for Improved Shops SVE. Joja now sells groceries. Removed 40 items donated and letter requirement from the mod making dwarf scrolls available from Spring 1 Year 1.

1.8 This is the final update. I will be moving on to Improved Shops SVE. The only change I made is restoring the strawberry seeds in Pierre's

[/b][u][b]Compatibility[/b][/u]
Fully compatible with all significant mods

[u]How to install[/u]
[list=1]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi 4.4.0 or later[/url]
[*]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher 2.0.8 or later[/url]
[*]Make sure that the game is on at least 1.6
[*]Download the main file and extract it into your mods folder﻿﻿[b]﻿[/b]
[/list]
Enjoy!
